executeNested

public void executeNested(JdbcQueryHandler queryHandler)
                   throws java.sql.SQLException
Description copied from interface: JdbcQueryHandler
Provides support for nested queries. Some queries require that an additional java.sql.Statement be created and invoked within the scope of the first query, i.e., before the outer Statement and ResultSet have been closed. Resources within inner-most nested JdbcQueryHandler instances will be closed before those within the containing JdbcQueryHandler.

Specified by:
executeNested in interface JdbcQueryHandler
Throws:
java.sql.SQLException

setHaltOnError

public void setHaltOnError(boolean haltOnError)
Description copied from interface: JdbcQueryHandler
The haltOnError switch is initialized to true by default. It is used to determine if execution of a given set of JdbcQueryHandler instances will be halted in the event of an exception thrown by JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults(). Users can set this switch to true to prevent termination of all queries if this query throws an exception.

Specified by:
setHaltOnError in interface JdbcQueryHandler
